name: Bedfordshire
description: Bedfordshire is a largely rural county in the East of England, known for rolling farmland, market towns and historic country estates. Bedford and Luton are its main urban centres, with strong connections to London and the wider Midlands.

places.name: Bedford
places.description: A market town on the River Great Ouse in Bedfordshire, historically linked to John Bunyan, author of The Pilgrim's Progress, who was imprisoned here.

places.name: Central Bedfordshire
places.description: A district in Bedfordshire covering a mix of market towns and villages, including Leighton Buzzard and Ampthill, on London's northern commuter fringe.

places.name: Luton
places.description: A town in Bedfordshire historically built on hat-making, today better known as home to London Luton Airport and a diverse, multicultural population.
